links.outcome: Readability grade level and reading duration of ChatGPT versus Google Search answers
links.effect: ChatGPT results were at an overall higher-grade reading level with a longer reading duration than Google Search answer box and snippets.
links.quote: The ChatGPT results were determined to be at an overall higher-grade reading level, with a longer reading duration, less accurate, less current, and with a less effective delivery of information.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT against Google Search for answering patient questions about missed oral contraception pills, assessing readability, accuracy, and recency without testing specific deployment safeguards.
